verdict.rationale: Gusto's payroll docs say companies may want different pay schedules based on location or job type (gusto-docs-48, gusto-docs-31). Regular payrolls are pre-generated from each company's pay schedule and pay periods (gusto-docs-62), and the official CLI includes a `gusto pay-schedule` command (gusto-contest-61-1). This covers the core of running multiple schedules across groups of workers. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the supported frequencies (weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly), detail on assigning schedules to teams or departments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
